Which means they'll be winding down at the exact moment you'd hope they'd be celebrating a payoff from years of work. 
Read more
articles.title: Studio known for anti-capitalist games shut down by their publisher just two weeks before their newest game comes out

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
There comes a time in every cat owner's life where they must ask themselves: how large would this creature need to be before it attempted to bat me around like a catnip mouse? I suspect the answer is "only as large as it needed to be", so it's fortunate that Monster Hunter Wilds' Palicoes are apparently bred for helpfulness. Is installing a mod to the action game that makes them tall as humans a form of gene splicing? Don't worry, hunter. Gene splicing is how nature heals itself.
Read more
articles.title: Sure, why not: here's a Monster Hunter Wilds mod to make your Palico very large

articles.author: RPS
articles.description:
Another Steam Next Fest is drawing to a close, having had to compete with Monster Hunter Wilds for PC-beholding eyeballs – yet losing none of its knack for highlighting interesting and offbeat games set for future release. A quick dangle of our indie demo astrolabe indicates we’re a few months off the next Next Fest, though at the time of posting, there are still a couple of precious hours to download and try out the best samplers that this wintery showcase has to offer. Here are our favourites from the past week, and if you’ve played something you think deserves some more attention, why not share it in the comments?
Read more
articles.title: Our favourite demos from Steam Next Fest Winter 2025

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
GTA 6 developers Rockstar Games have announced the acquisition of Video Games Deluxe, the Sydney-based team who collaborated with them on the 2017 re-release of L.A. Noire, virtual reality spin-off L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files and, most recently, post-launch updates for Grove Street's Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition. The studio will now be known as (drum roll please) Rockstar Australia.
 
Read more
articles.title: GTA 6 developers buy L.A. Noire director's studio, rename it Rockstar Australia

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds has been racking up the skulls, attracting well over a million simultaneous Steam players this weekend despite a mixed player reaction, with particular scorn reserved for its technical performance.
Now begins the process of patching the behemoth to address some player-reported problems with certain quests. Patching is sort of like slaughtering a Monster in reverse: sewing on horns and tails rather than chopping them off, re-embowelling the shackled form of the creature so that it can gallop across the plains, monstrous and free.
 
Read more
articles.title: First Monster Hunter Wilds updates fix a progress-blocking bug, but not the dodgy PC performance

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 developers Saber Interactive are pushing back on player calls to add an even-harder difficulty mode, following the introduction of an Absolute difficulty setting this spring via game update.
Apparently, some of you muscleheads have been finding Absolute "a bit easy", or at least, not enough of a shake-up from the preceding Lethal difficulty. Saber are open to suggestions, here, but game director Dmitriy Grigorenko also reckons that "we are almost at our limit in terms of how we can make the game harder without making it unfair and not fun". 

 
Read more
articles.title: Space Marine 2 devs push back on calls for a difficulty mode above Absolute - "we are almost at our limit"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Good morrow to ye, stranger! This week's new PC game round-up is jam-packed indeed - absolutely sardine-canned. So let's skip the customary preamble about the Maw's digestive habits and proceed directly to the banqueting table.
 Read more
articles.title: The Maw: what's new in PC games this week?

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
If you’ve been trying to buy an RTX 5080, you already know it’s nearly impossible to find. Nvidia’s new GPU has been selling out instantly, with standalone cards unavailable or listed at outrageous resale prices. That’s why this deal from Dell is worth a look. The Alienware Aurora R16 gaming PC includes an RTX 5080 for just $2,399.99 right now.
 Read more
articles.title: I finally found a reasonably priced RTX 5080 pre-built gaming PC: Alienware Aura R16 for under $2400

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Lubricate your brain with some pure Omega-3 oils, a new puzzle game from the makers of Opus Magnum and Eliza has been announced. Kaizen: A Factory Story will be an "open-ended puzzle automation game from the original Zachtronics team, set in 1980s Japan" in which you'll build toy robots, computers, TVs, and... katsu curry? Well, why not. Although the studio behind this engineer 'em up is technically new, the main designers - Zach Barth and Matthew Seiji Burns - are the same folks who brought you Exapunks, TIS-100, and Shenzhen I/O. This, my friends, is very good news. 
Read more
articles.title: Zachtronics designers return with a new puzzler set in 1980s Tokyo

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Hello reader who is also a reader, and welcome back to Booked For The Week - our regular Sunday chat with a selection of cool industry folks about books! "Nic, you selfless paragon. You champion of the people. You prince among men. I can't believe you put your favourite column on pause for several weeks to let me finish my book!". Please. I'm sure you would have done the same, were you also a dashing genius with a moustache powerful enough to crack the pyramids.
To ring in the resurrection with style, it's The Norwood Suite, Betrayal At Club Low, and Moves Of The Diamond Hand's Cosmo D! Cheers Cosmo! Mind if we have a nose at your bookshelf?
Read more
articles.title: What's on your bookshelf?: The Norwood Suite and Betrayal At Club Low's Cosmo D

articles.author: Graham Smith
articles.description:
Sundays are for asking for forgiveness, since I missed Sunday Papers entirely last weekend. Alas, I was stricken by a deep malaise, but I return now with renewed vigour and another roundup of links to good writing from across the web. Some of the good writing is even about games this time.

For the LA Review Of Books, Celine Nguyen reviewed Building SimCity, Chaim Gingold's book about the creation of SimCity.

 
Read more
articles.title: The Sunday Papers

articles.author: Ollie Toms
articles.description:
Thank you all for your wonderful soundtrack suggestions earlier this week! I'll be gleefully ploughing my way through them over the coming workdays. But now isn't the time for that! Weekends are for the playing, not the listening of the playing!
Here's what we're all clicking on this weekend.
 Read more
articles.title: What are we all playing this weekend?

articles.author: Graham Smith
articles.description:
RPS's corporate daddy has announced that IGN Live is returning this June. The in-person event aims to fill the void left by E3, with playable demos in LA and livestreams of game reveals and panels for those who can't attend.

 
Read more
articles.title: IGN Live is coming back this June for a multi-day event and livestream

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Coatsink have announced a sequel to Islanders, their pastelcore seaside town-arranger, which was the last game Alec Meer ever reviewed for RPS. Until he reviewed Kentucky Route Zero: Act V, a year or so later. If I didn't know better, I'd say Alec had planned that deliberately to screw me up. But I'll forgive him because the KRZ review is very good and thoughtful, and also because the first trailer for Islanders: New Shores is extremely calming. Here you go.
 Read more
articles.title: Islanders: New Shores is the follow-up to 2019's gentlest town-builder

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v GNOME nejen o portování aplikací pro GTK 4, dílčí aktualizace OpenRazer 3.10.1 s podporou dalších zařízení, digiKam 8.6 s radikálně vylepšenými AI modely pro rozpoznáváním tváří a objektů.
articles.title: KDE se připravuje na konec podpory X11, digiKam výrazně navyšuje použití AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Foťáků je tisíc, objektivů milión a názorů na to, jaké lepší tělo si měl člověk koupit, minimálně miliarda. Nikdo se neumí hádat tak jako fotografové. Někteří prahnou po špičkové technice, jiní prostě fotí.
articles.title: Proč fotím 17 let starou zrcadlovkou? Fotky nedělá technika, ale člověk za ní

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jozef Krajčovič)
articles.description: V záverečnej časti pokračujeme v rozprávaní o ďalšom zo spôsobov komunikácie za frontovými líniami – holubou poštou a dozvieme sa, ako sa vodilo nášmu umelcovi tajomstiev – hrdinovi G.W. Bellym pri lúštení novinových inzerátov.
articles.title: Potulky tmavými zákutiami kryptológie: holubia pošta a inzeráty

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Proč se většina nově přidaných instrukcí SSE omezuje na práci s hodnotami typu single, když je mnoho aplikací založených na celočíselných datech nebo naopak používá typ double? Odpovědí byla instrukční sada SSE2.
articles.title: Od instrukční sady SSE k sadě SSE2

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Svatopluk Vít)
articles.description: Nekupoval jsem bezzrcadlovku v sadě s objektivem, protože si chci vybrat vlastní sklo, pro focení sportu v hale vhodnější. Parametrů je mnoho. Jaké nakonec rozhodly a kde se dá ušetřit a nepřijít o obrazovou kvalitu?
articles.title: Fotograf amatér: jakým sklem se dívat na svět?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes si představíme ovládací panel webhostingu, nahrajeme si dění na obrazovce, přehrajeme si hudbu a vyzkoušíme otevřenou alternativu k MongoDB.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (12. 3. 2025): připravte si svůj vlastní webhosting

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Eischmann)
articles.description: Soukromí při práci na mobilních telefonech je dnes ohroženo nejen aplikacemi, ale i systémovými službami. Můžete vyzkoušet alternativní systém GrapheneOS, který sběr dat minimalizuje. Jak moc je to omezující?
articles.title: GrapheneOS: Android pro lehce paranoidní uživatele

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Dokončíme popis rozšíření instrukční sady SSE. Ukážeme si některé netriviální operace, které je možné provádět se skaláry a především s vektory. Jedná se o konverzní operace a taktéž o rozbalování a zabalování prvků vektorů.
articles.title: Pokročilejší SSE operace: přeskupení, promíchání a rozbalování prvků vektorů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: V dnešním souhrnu týdenního dění okolo kybernetické bezpečnosti se podíváme na Botnet Eleven11bot, odpojení polské vesmírné agentury od internetu, útoky na japonské společnosti a novou zranitelnost v Kibaně.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: nový botnet Eleven11bot otřásá kyberprostorem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Projekt postmarketOS hledá nové jméno. Gentoo nabízí připravené obrazy disků ve formátu QCOW2. Nadace UBports Foundation oznámila vydání Ubuntu Touch OTA-8 s podporou VoLTE pro Volla Phone X23 a Volla Phone 22.
articles.title: Nové jméno pro postmarketOS, připravené obrazy Gentoo

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: peci1)
articles.description: Oblíbená GitHub Action tj-actions/changed-files byla před několika dny napadena a začala krást CI tokeny, hesla a další zajímavé údaje, ke kterým se dostane. Vypadá to, že napadeno bylo více tagů.
articles.title: GitHub Action tj-actions/changed-files napadena, krade tokeny, hesla a další údaje

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Ministerstvo vnitra připravilo změnu vyhlášky ve které nově ukládá poskytovatelům připojení od 1. července povinnost zaznamenávat stránky navštívené zákazníky. Dnes se premiér Petr Fiala  vyslovil proti návrhu:
articles.title: Premiér Petr Fiala se vyslovil proti návrhu vyhlášky o zaznamenávání navštívených stránek

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Antivirový program Microsoft Defender od úterý ve Windows odstraňuje soubor s ovladačem WinRing0 jako škodlivý. Teno ovladač však používají různé monitorovací nástroje jako FanControl, CPU-Z, Razer Synapse, SteelSeries Engine, OpenRGB, Libre Hardware Monitor, CapFrameX, MSI Afterburner, OmenMon, ZenTimings a Panorama9.
articles.title: Defender ve Windows odstraňuje WinRing0 jako škodlivý, monitorovací software jako FanControl přestane fungovat

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Dnes je 14. března, což znamená, že svůj svátek slaví Rút. Jméno je to původně hebrejské a odvozené od slova reúth, které znamená „přátelství“. Přejeme tedy všem rootům, routám a routerům všechno nejlepší k svátku! Hlavně si zachovejte dobré zdraví a veselou náladu.
articles.title: Dnes má svátek Rút, hodně štěstí všem rootům

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Již o tomto víkendu 15. a 16. března probíhá v Praze tradiční konference InstallFest. V rozsáhlém programu najdete desítky přednášek a pět prakticky zaměřených workshopů. Těšit se můžete na mobilní telefony se svobodnými operačními systémy, linuxové distribuce, otevřený hardware, vývoj, počítačové sítě a další témata.
articles.title: O víkendu probíhá v Praze na Karlově náměstí konference InstallFest

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Windows 10 (22H2) a Windows 11 (22H2 a 23H2, 24H2 se to netýká) po nepovinné preview aktualizaci KB5050092 z 29. ledna mohou mít problémy s USB tiskárnami, které podporují oba protokoly USB Print i IPP over USB.
articles.title: Windows po aktualizaci tiskne na USB tiskárně nesmyslný text

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Eischmann)
articles.description: Po 11 letech se do Prahy vrací Flock, konference pro přispěvatele a příznivce Fedory. Bude se konat od 5. do 8. června v hotelu Vienna House by Wyndham na Andělu. Na konferenci je potřeba registrace, vstupné je dobrovolné.
articles.title: Konference Flock se vrací do Prahy, proběhne od 5. do 8. června

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Někteří uživatelé dávají přednost novému AI vyhledávání před klasickým vyhledáváním. Minulý týden publikovaná studie amerického časopisu Columbia Journalism Review, určeného hlavně profesionálním žurnalistům, zkoumala osm AI vyhledávačů: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Perplexity Pro, DeepSeek Search, Copilot, Grok 2 Search, Grok 3 Search a Gemini.
articles.title: AI vyhledávání špatně cituje zdroje v 60 % případů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Uživatelům před několika dny přestaly fungovat multimediální přehrávače Chromecast druhé generace. Ukázalo se, že za problémem stojí starý certifikát, který vypršel o víkendu. Google nyní tvrdí, že připravil opravený firmware a začal jej postupně nahrává na postižená zařízení. Může prý trvat několik dnů, než se oprava dostane na všechny Chromecasty.
articles.title: Google vydal opravu pro Chromecast, měla by se rozšířit během několika dnů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Ministerstvo vnitra připravuje vyhlášku, která by poskytovatelům připojení k internetu ukládala povinnost zaznamenávat, jaké webové stránky jejich zákazníci navštěvují. Návrh vyhlášky byl během dnešního dne zveřejněn na Portále ODok Úřadu vlády České republiky.
articles.title: Stát chce od operátorů přístup k údajům o webových stránkách, které uživatelé navštěvují

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: PeoplePath)
articles.description: Společnost PeoplePath pořádá v Plzni workshopy na různá IT témata. Tentokrát bylo téma „Když programovací jazyky překvapí: Počkej, tohle není bug, ale feature?“ a byl pořízen videozáznam.
articles.title: Video z workshopu Když programovací jazyky překvapí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Mozilla varuje uživatele prohlížeče Firefox, aby aktualizovali svůj prohlížeč na nejnovější verzi a vyhnuli se tak výpadku a bezpečnostním rizikům způsobeným blížícím se vypršením platnosti jednoho z kořenových certifikátů organizace. Platnost certifikátu vyprší už v pátek 14. března 2025 a byl používán k podepisování obsahu, včetně doplňků pro různé projekty Mozilla a samotný Firefox.
articles.title: Mozilla upozorňuje uživatele, aby aktualizovali Firefox před vypršením certifikátu

MLB The Show 25 is the series' latest chapter, which will be released globally on March 18. However, I am afraid there is some bad news for the PC Master Race members.


As usual, the latest release is developed by a PlayStation studio (San Diego Studio), but it's not exclusive to Sony's gaming ecosystem. However, like the last few years, the game is a console exclusive, which is bad news for those who play games on their PCs. For yet another year, MLB The Show 25 will not be released on PC. It's only available on the current-gen Xbox, PlayStation, and the Nintendo Switch consoles.


Why is MLB The Show 25 not on PC


The exact reason behind the game's absence on PC is unknown. Usually, games developed by PlayStation studios are exclusively meant for the PlayStation console. In this case, the publisher is MLB, so it's available for the Nintendo Switch and the Xbox Series X|S.


A major reason might be the mandatory requirement of a controller. You can also play on a PC using a keyboard and mouse, but a controller is compulsory for playing The Show games. This seems to be the likeliest reason why MLB isn't publishing its baseball simulators on PC.




Whether The Show eventually makes its way over to PC remains to be seen. If you're eager to play MLB The Show 25, the Nintendo Switch version will be the cheapest alternative (including the console price). To get the full experience, you'll have to rely on the PS5 or the Xbox Series X|S console. You can opt between the Standard and the Digital Deluxe Edition.


While both editions are good choices at different prices, the Digital Deluxe Edition is perfect for those who will grind the Diamond Dynasty mode. It includes many goodies that will allow you a head start. If you buy the Standard Edition, there's no early access, and you'll have to wait until March 18 to enjoy the gameplay.

Fans of the One Piece anime have been waiting for the anime's return for months now. While there's still a bit more waiting to go, it won't be for long. After all, the One Piece anime will be resuming with the Egghead Arc this April.


The anime started its six-month hiatus in October last year, citing a need to recharge as the reason. However, fans weren't left hanging. During the break, the well-received One Piece Fan Letter special and a remastered version of the Fishman Island Arc was aired in the anime's usual time slot.


Image via Crunchyroll


The upcoming return


Unlike the momentous 3D/2Y change in the franchise, the anime will follow the original plan. It will resume airing the Egghead Arc on April 6. Furthermore, Crunchyroll confirmed that the platform will be simulcasting the return in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and Latin America. All previous episodes are also available to stream on the platform.


IGN also released the English-subbed teaser trailer for the anime's upcoming return, giving us a glimpse of what the recharged production team will deliver. Furthermore, we will be hearing Subaru Kimura as Franky for the first time as the series resumes.


Image via Crunchyroll


About the Egghead Arc


Egghead Island is unlike any location the Straw Hat Pirates have visited before. Dubbed the "Island of the Future," it is home to the genius scientist Dr. Vegapunk and his many creations. The arc promises thrilling encounters as the crew navigates a technologically advanced world filled with new allies and dangerous enemies.


One of the central plotlines of the Egghead Arc is the revelation of crucial information regarding the Void Century — the mysterious past that the World Government has long tried to suppress. Additionally, the arc finally reveals the power the enigmatic Five Elders hold.

As you progress through your Outlaw Keycard quests in Fortnite, you'll encounter an objective asking to purchase an item from an Outlaw Vending Machine. Where do you find these? How much do items cost? Are any of them worth it? That's what we're here to find out.


How to find an Outlaw Vending Machine in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2


Outlaw vending machines mainly appear in Seaport City, Masked Meadows, and Crime City. Throughout these landmarks, you'll find vending machine icons on your map, usually appearing alongside decorative machines. These three spots also have multiple vending machines, so you don't have to worry about searching an entire city for one location.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Each vending machine usually has one of Fortnite's outlaws' names, such as Joss, Skillet, or Keisha Cross. If you see a name along the lines of "Joss' Vending Machine," you'll know you're in the right spot. They usually have a bright and colorful appearance, differentiating them from regular decorative items around the map.


Every vending machine offers two Thermite for 100 gold bars and a Plasma Burst Laser for 600 gold bars. The third and final item differs from each machine, but it's usually an epic-quality gun like an AR, sniper rifle, or SMG. These weapons almost always cost 600 gold bars, so make sure to save up some money before visiting one. Even outside of quests, vending machines are helpful if you want to break into a vault and need Thermite or want a quick and easy weapon. 


Getting enough gold for these items is pretty easy if you break into enough vaults, eliminate a few players, or open a bunch of treasure chests for loot. You can also break gold veins for some extra bars and the Gold Rush buff for a quick movement speed boost.

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Reports of a major outage at Spotify spread like wildfire last week. Then a curious picture began to emerge, one of outages only affecting those using modified Spotify apps designed to provide the Premium service at the free tier price. News that the problem has now been fixed and those in need can download new pirate apps, means that many are rushing to do so. Whether that will end well seems to hang in the balance. Could go this way, or could go that.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: How Spotify’s Premium Piracy Panic Played Out & What Pirates Did Next

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Popular torrent site TorrentGalaxy has been offline for two weeks, with no explanation from its operators. Members of the site's staff are also being kept in the dark, and many fear the site may never return. To the delight of copyright holders, the site's troubles are now being felt across the torrent ecosystem after the site's upload bots also stopped working.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: TorrentGalaxy Staff Fear the Worst as Site Stays Dark and Upload Bots Fail

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
After 15 years or so of relatively plain sailing, comment platform Disqus is cracking down on sites that violate its terms of service. Pirate manga and anime sites have received notifications that Disqus will no longer provide services after copyright infringement came to its attention. With evictions now spreading to sites including FitGirl Repacks and KickassAnime, it's a race against the clock to export years of chat in the 24/48 hours notice given.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Disqus is Deleting Pirate Site Communities on Short Notice

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Swedish businessman Carl Lundström, founder of the telecoms company Rix Telecom and one of the Wasabröd heirs, died in a plane crash on Monday. Lundström played a pivotal role in the Pirate Bay's rise to fame by supporting the site early on. For his involvement in the site, he was eventually sentenced to four months in prison.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Early Pirate Bay Backer Carl Lundström Dies in Plane Crash

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new industry-backed report reveals that only a small fraction of takedown notices targeting pirated live streams result in suspensions, with dedicated server providers showing the lowest responsiveness. Rightsholders see the data as evidence that a previously issued recommendation by the EU failed to have an effect. Consequently, more needs to be done to tackle live streaming piracy.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Intermediaries Are (Still) Slow to Disconnect Pirate Live Streams, Report Finds

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta's legal battle over its alleged use of pirated books as AI training data continues to deliver new twists. Fresh allegations that Meta may have shared data with third parties while "leeching" from torrents have added a critical layer to the legal dispute. The book authors obtained permission to put a spotlight on Meta's "leeching" activity and, in addition, requested summary judgment on copyright infringement.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Authors Put a Spotlight on Meta’s BitTorrent Leeching Activity

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Following a complaint filed two years ago by a national pay-TV broadcaster, police in Germany say they now have three main suspects in custody following a huge law enforcement operation. Over 150 officers carried out searches against 18 suspects in 17 locations, with the aim of shutting down an as-yet unnamed illegal streaming operation with an estimated 30,000 subscribers. The three men, aged between 36 and 59, face charges including suspected commercial computer fraud, which carries a potential sentence of 10 years imprisonment.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Police Shut Down Pirate Streaming Network That Cost Broadcaster ‘Millions’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Anora was the big winner at the Oscars a week ago, securing awards for best picture, actress, and director, among others. This major achievement puts the movie in the spotlight and increases interest through both legal and illegal channels. Fresh data collected by TorrentFreak shows that pirate downloads surged right after the awards ceremony ended.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Oscar Winner ‘Anora’ Sees Massive Surge in Pirate Downloads

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
In December 2024, Microsoft Threat Intelligence identified a malware campaign stemming from pirate streaming sites. Using iframe malvertising redirector URLs to generate revenue, and redirects up to five layers deep, malware payloads hosted on GitHub, Discord and Dropbox, acted as a dropper for additional payloads hosted elsewhere. Microsoft says the goal was to steal information and it believes almost a million devices were infected.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Streaming Site Malware Campaign Infected One Million Devices

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Anora' tops the chart, followed by 'Captain America: Brave New World'. 'The Gorge' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 03/10/2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A former employee of a disc manufacturing company in Memphis has been indicted on charges of stealing and selling pre-release DVDs and Blu-rays of popular films, including "Spider-Man: No Way Home."  The indictment links the sales to widespread availability of the movie on pirate sites.  The defendant faces charges of criminal copyright infringement and interstate transportation of stolen goods, with potential penalties of up to 20 years imprisonment.    
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Employee Charged in ‘Spider-Man’ Pre-Release Blu-ray Theft Linked to Mass Piracy

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
New research on ad-funded piracy centers on manga site Tu Manga Online (TMO). After switching to a new domain 'zonatmo.com' around September last year, it took just 90 days to transform a new start into half a billion visits per month.  According to the research, the site's revenue generating scheme is an open secret. Yet, for unknown reasons, nobody tries to stop it.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Ad-Funded Piracy’s ‘Biggest Open Secret’ Revealed By Researcher

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Nintendo celebrated victory over French file-hosting service 1fichier.com this week. The French Supreme Court denied the filehoster's appeal and upheld a piracy liability ruling in favor of the gaming company. The ruling confirms that hosting platforms can be held liable if they fail to remove pirated content when asked. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Defeats Filehoster ‘1Fichier’ at French Supreme Court

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
As Spain's pirate site-blocking crisis persists for the fourth consecutive week, LaLiga's decision to block Cloudflare continues to affect innocent internet users and websites. Cloudflare took legal action last week hoping to stop LaLiga in its tracks. In a parallel process, cybersecurity group RootedCON has asked a court to strike out LaLiga's blocking authority. Meanwhile, RootedCON says moves are underway to undermine the authority of their lawyer.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: RootedCON: Pirate IPTV Blocking Appeal Accepted as Crisis Continues

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A single DMCA anti-circumvention notice, sent by Nintendo on the one-year anniversary of its 2024 lawsuit against Yuzu, showed just how much things can change in a year. Targeting nine repos linked to Switch emulator Ryujinx, the domino effect led to the removal of 4,238 repos. Elsewhere, the distilled components of Yuzu's demise can be found in recent takedown notices
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Easily Kills 4,238 Switch Emu Repos on Yuzu Lawsuit Anniversary

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Members of the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE) filed two separate copyright infringement lawsuits yesterday, targeting the alleged operators of IPTV services including 'Outer Limits IPTV', 'Shrugs' and 'Zing'. Amazon, Netflix and several major Hollywood studios demand an end to the infringing activity and an award for damages, which could run to millions of dollars. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Hollywood Studios Sue Pirate IPTV Services in U.S. Court

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The BBC, Premier League, and Sky have submitted a joint response to the UK investigation into Google's search dominance, calling for tougher anti-piracy measures. The rightsholders argue that Google's current efforts to combat piracy are insufficient to prevent piracy. They propose a "Know Your Customer" (KYC) requirement for advertisers and a transparent repeat infringer policy to address the issue.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: BBC, Premier League & Sky Seek Tougher UK Regs to Deter Google Search Piracy

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A court in Murcia, Spain, has ordered Google to testify in a criminal case concerning IPTV app, NewPlay. Football league LaLiga, whose matches were allegedly offered illegally through the app, previously called for the directors of Google, Apple, and Huawei to face criminal charges. LaLiga criticized the companies for failing to disable copies of NewPlay already installed on users' devices. Google and Huawei must now testify as 'profit-making participants' in an alleged piracy scheme.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google Must Testify as LaLiga Demands Criminal Liability For ‘Piracy Profits’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In response to several court orders, Cloudflare geoblocked more than 400 sports streaming piracy domain names on its pass-through service in France last year. Notably. Cloudflare says that, despite requests, it has not blocked any websites through the 1.1.1.1 Public DNS Resolver. That last comment is relevant to the renewed site blocking push in the United States. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare Blocked 400+ Sports Piracy Domains in France Last Year

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Yuv422)
articles.description:
Dark Seed, a 90's point-and-click horror game from the mind of H.R. Giger, is now ready for public testing!
In the game you play the role of Mike Dawson, who just moved to a beautiful solitary mansion to pursue his dream of becoming a writer. You'll soon realise that the place harbors dark secrets, and you'll have just three days to escape a fate worse than death...
The DOS Floppy and CD versions are supported. The engine also supports a number of localised versions Spanish, French, German, Korean and Chinese.
The floppy version currently lacks sound effects but all other features from the original game should be present.
The engine also has the option of using the "arguably" better floppy music with the CD version if you have both.
To participate in the testing, ensure you have a daily development build. As always, please submit the bug reports to our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: A dark seed has been planted

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sev)
articles.description:
Good news: We've been accepted again to the Google Summer of Code program!
So, if you feel adventurous (or RPGous) and would like to spend your summer with the cool team, we look forward to your application.
Fear not—we will provide enough handholding, explanations, and support if you can dedicate time to coding on our project, are an open-minded developer ready to learn, and do not hesitate to ask any questions. We've been doing GSoC for the last 18 years (oh my gosh), so we know the drill.
A list of suggested projects can be found on this page. If you have your own idea, we will gladly evaluate it. For example, this happened in 2023 with the Crab engine. The required information for your application for our project is listed on our Wiki.
To give you a nice boost, we have put together an impressive amount of information on the Google Summer of Code miniportal. So you can learn all the ins and outs of the process. But indeed, you need to start by joining our Discord server and follow the #scummvm-gsoc channel where you can engage with our mentors and the rest of the team.
We are looking forward to your fine application and participation!
>
articles.title: ScummVM has been accepted to the Google Summer of Code 2025

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Inovativní koncept, který velmi dobře funguje, pokud od něj neočekáváte realističnost (je to koncekonců adaptace komiksu). Nápadité, dojemné, technicky zajímavé, mírně retro. Spoustu podobných filmů v 80. letech produkoval Spielberg. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Here - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Daniel Craig v moci drog a alkoholu klátí mladé hochy v Mexiku a chtěl by klátit jiného mladého hocha a otevřít si s ním mysl. Když si odmyslíme potenciální skandálnost erotických scén, děje se toho v tomto filmu velice málo a velice zdlouhavě, a spíš doporučuji Cronenbergův "Nahý oběd", který je o téže postavě a méně nudný. Vlastně mi tenhle film připomněl soft-core "artové" počiny minulých dekád jako "Emmanuelle" nebo "Divoká orchidej". (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Queer - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Slušně zručně natočeno, ale pokud už jste viděli pár dramat o zprávařích v 70. letech, nedočkáte se ničeho nového. Teroristický útok v Mnichově je jen jakýsi "zdroj dramatu" v pozadí a nedozvíte se o něm v tomto filmu o mnoho více než v prvních 20 minutách Spielbergova "Mnichova". (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Mnichov 1972 [September 5] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Měl jsem zásadní problém s tím, jak je film POMALÝ. Nevydržím se dívat na pomalý tříminutový dialog se zcela nehybnou kamerou. Bez ohledu na to, jak zajímavá je kompozice záběru. Kdyby totéž natočil třeba Guy Ritchie, mohlo to celé mít 18 minut (místo 109) a výsledný divácký efekt mohl být stejný. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Na kordy [刺心切骨 / Pierce] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Velmi špatný scénář, který je nudný pro dospělé a nepochopitelný pro děti. Průměrné herecké výkony, rutinní režie a především zbytečně vyhozené peníze za drahou výpravu. Většinu filmu dělá dvacet zaměnitelných dětí několikrát totéž dokola (naložit parašutistu do vozu, přejet pár kilometrů, přespat ve stodole, naložit parašutistu...). (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Tichá pošta - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Zábavné a nápadité smrti, občas dobrý vtípek nebo extrémní WTF moment, občas originální audiovizuální nápad, ale jinak... nic. Na konci jsem si uvědomil, že mě od poloviny filmu přestala zajímat jeho zápletka a hrdinové. Těch WTF vtípků ve filmu není dost na to, aby ho samy o sobě utáhly. Byla by to super epizody nějakých "příběhů ze záhrobí", ale na celovečerní film je to bohužel málo. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Opice [The Monkey] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Čistě konverzační film bez jakékoliv zápletky, který se snaží vzbudit mírně povznášející atmosféru a nějaké divákovo souznění s hlavními postavami (a nic jiného). Takové filmy mohou být dobré, pokud jsou výborně napsané, odehrané a zrežírované, což bohužel není případ "Opravdové bolesti". (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Opravdová bolest [A Real Pain] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: První třetina byla výborná, atmosférická a chytrá. Pak přišla trocha (stále fungující) romantiky a v polovině se to zcela překlopilo v Resident Evil 11 (nebo kolik). Pořád to bylo celkem zábavné a vizuálně působivé, ale nemůžu ignorovat ten z mého pohledu promarněný potenciál začátku. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Roklina [The Gorge] - 70 %

articles.description:
USN-7343-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Jinja2. The update introduced a
regression when attempting to import Jinja2 on Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. This update fixes the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Original advisory details:

Rafal Krupinski discovered that Jinja2 did not properly restrict
the execution of code in situations where templates are used maliciously.
An attacker with control over a template's filename and content could
potentially use this issue to enable the execution of arbitrary code.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS and Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.
(CVE-2024-56201)

It was discovered that Jinja2 sandboxed environments could be escaped
through a call to a string format method. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to enable the execution of arbitrary code. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS and Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-56326)

It was discovered that Jinja2 sandboxed environments could be escaped
through the malicious use of certain filters. An attacker could possibly
use this issue to enable the execution of arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-27516)
articles.title: USN-7343-2: Jinja2 regression

tricked into processing a specially crafted RAR archive, a remote attacker

service. (CVE-2024-33899)

articles.description:
It was discovered that the Python ipaddress module contained incorrect
information about which IP address ranges were considered “private” or
“globally reachable”. This could possibly result in applications applying
incorrect security policies. This issue only affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
and Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-4032)

It was discovered that Python incorrectly handled quoting path names when
using the venv module. A local attacker able to control virtual
environments could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code when
the virtual environment is activated. (CVE-2024-9287)

It was discovered that Python incorrectly handled parsing bracketed hosts.
A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform a Server-Side
Request Forgery (SSRF) attack. This issue only affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
and Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-11168)

It was discovered that Python incorrectly handled parsing domain names that
included square brackets. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to perform a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attack. (CVE-2025-0938)
